I’m going to teach you something simple, but very useful in trading. When you see the EUR/USD in the green, avoid looking for short positions on BTC at all costs. A weak dollar tends to favour risk assets, and Bitcoin is often more likely to show strength. Conversely, when the EUR/USD falls and the dollar strengthens, BTC may be more vulnerable to downward pressure. It’s not an absolute rule and shouldn’t be used as an entry trigger, but it’s a macro correlation worth keeping an eye on at all times. The secret is to trade with the trend, not against it.
